title: MatchEvent
description: MatchEvent wire contract. GOAL_ANNULLED accepts legacy reference_event_id or annuls_event_id. If both are non-null they must be identical; equality, existence and same-match GOAL validation are enforced by codecs/domain, not JSON Schema. Producer emission remains reference_event_id during reader migration.

minute.description: Initial project simulation limit, not a universal football rule.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp using the RFC 3339 date-time profile. Validators must enable format assertion.

reference_event_id.description: For GOAL_ANNULLED, identifies the original GOAL event; existence is not checked by JSON Schema.

annuls_event_id.description: GOAL_ANNULLED-only alias of reference_event_id. Non-null aliases must match when both are provided.
